improvements.areaName: SEO Meta Description and OG Tags
improvements.suggestion:
<meta name="description" content="Gideon is your AI-powered trade and business assistant. Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support for operations and trade decisions. Try three free searches today.">
<meta property="og:title" content="Gideon – AI Trade & Business Assistant | GDN AI">
<meta property="og:description" content="Your Claude-powered assistant for trade and business. Instant AI answers, voice chat, and unlimited workspace access. Start with three free searches.">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:image" content="https://gdn.ai/og-image.jpg">
<meta property="og:url" content="https://gdn.ai/">
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
<meta name="twitter:title" content="Gideon – AI Trade & Business Assistant">
<meta name="twitter:description" content="Claude-powered AI for business owners, traders, and professionals. Try three free searches.">
improvements.rationale: A compelling meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly stating what Gideon does and the free trial offer. Open Graph tags ensure professional, branded previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, or Facebook—critical for B2B audiences. Including the three free searches call-to-action creates immediate interest without overpromising.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat support, and professional guidance for your business operations. Try 3 free searches today."
improvements.rationale: This headline immediately introduces the product name and core function, establishing clarity and trust. The subheading reinforces key value props (instant answers, voice chat, professional support) while highlighting the low-friction free trial offer to drive conversions. Copy remains factual, concise, and aligned with the confident, professional tone.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to choose a membership plan to continue. Plans start from just US$2 per day, billed monthly or annually—with annual billing saving you 30 percent. As a member, you'll unlock unlimited access to Gideon's AI-powered workspace, voice chat, and professional trade and business support.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in a freemium model—what happens at the paywall. By clearly explaining the transition from free trial to paid membership, including transparent pricing and benefits, it reduces uncertainty and builds trust, helping convert trial users into paying members.
